name: HH breakout 19 — failed-breakout reversal, fast reclaim (5m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same trap — a failed downside break that reclaims the range signals trapped shorts who must cover — but on a FAST 5m clock, which is a genuinely different microstructure regime: the trap is detected and traded within minutes, catching the immediate cover cascade before it decays. Detect range_position crossing UP through a fitted reclaim level (cross_up) while adx is low and vol_realized is not elevated (a range, not a real freefall we are catching a knife in). Go LONG the reclaim. The 5m clock and the vol_realized guard (vs bb_width in variant 17) make this a distinct, higher-frequency cell that is much more fee- and fill-sensitive. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the reclaim sequence has no edge over simply being at the low (the trap adds nothing), OR — most likely at 5m — if realistic fills/slippage on a 5m bar erase the reversal profit (net-of-fees profit factor <1.2 on holdout), OR if it only survives on illiquid alts where the 5m fills are fictional (spread wider than the reversal), OR if the vol_realized guard is decorative.
catalyst: fast reclaim of the range after a failed downside break
